mapper.select: SELECT o.order_id, o.order_no, o.user_id, u.username, u.nickname, o.total_price, o.pay_status, o.pay_type, o.order_status, o.extra_info, o.create_time, o.pay_time FROM tb_order o LEFT JOIN tb_user u ON o.user_id = u.user_id WHERE o.order_id = #{orderId} AND o.is_deleted = 0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_order WHERE DATE(create_time) = DATE('now', 'localtime') AND is_deleted = 0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_order WHERE DATE(create_time) = DATE('now', 'localtime') AND pay_status = 1 AND is_deleted = 0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_order WHERE DATE(create_time) = DATE('now', 'localtime') AND order_status = 2 AND is_deleted = 0
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_price), 0) FROM tb_order WHERE DATE(create_time) = DATE('now', 'localtime') AND pay_status = 1 AND is_deleted = 0

SELECT DATE(create_time) AS stat_date, COUNT(*) AS order_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN pay_status = 1 THEN total_price ELSE 0 END), 0) AS sales FROM tb_order WHERE create_time >= DATE('now', 'localtime', '-6 days') AND is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY DATE(create_time) ORDER BY stat_date ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_order SET order_status = #{orderStatus}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND is_deleted = 0
UPDATE tb_order SET is_deleted = 1, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE order_id = #{orderId}

UPDATE tb_order SET is_deleted = 1, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE order_id IN
#{id}
